LanguageData.MRP_AnalyzeMechDesc: Begin resonance analysis of a mechanoid kind.\n\nRequires {0} plasteel and {1} advanced components delivered into the synchronizer, then have the mechanoid enter. The analysis takes {2}x the destructive scan duration. The mechanoid survives and is released afterwards.
LanguageData.MRP_CancelAnalysisDesc: Abort the analysis mode. The occupant and any unloaded materials will be ejected and returned.
LanguageData.MRP_WaitingIngredients: Waiting for analysis materials to be delivered…
LanguageData.MRP_NoAnalyzableMechs: There are no mechanoids eligible for analysis.
LanguageData.MRP_ScannerRequiresRecipe: Mechanoids without a gestation recipe cannot use subcore scanners. Analyze this kind in a neural synchronizer instead.
LanguageData.MRP_AnalysisProjectDesc: Resonance analysis of the {0}.\n\nThis project cannot be researched at a bench. Deliver the materials to a neural synchronizer and have the mechanoid enter it to complete a non-destructive analysis (about {1} hours).
LanguageData.MRP_AnalysisPlaceholderDesc: The analysis record of this mechanoid kind, compiled by the neural synchronizer.
LanguageData.MRP_AlreadyAnalyzed: Analysis of {0} was already completed; the mechanoid was released without consuming materials.
